seoTitle: Which Friends Character Are You? Friends Test (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Friends test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler or Ross — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one who organises everyone, the one who makes a joke when things get awkward, or the one who'd never, ever share their food? Answer 10 questions about how you really handle friends, dating and everyday life, and find out which of the six you are.

characters.name: Rachel Green
characters.title: The Stylish Reinventor
characters.summary: You're fun, fashionable and braver than people give you credit for. You've walked away from the safe option before, and it turned out to be the best thing you ever did.
description: Like Rachel, you know that the life everyone expects for you isn't always the one you want. She ran out of her own wedding, turned up at Central Perk in the dress, and started again from nothing.

You worked your way up. Rachel went from being a famously bad waitress to an assistant buyer at Bloomingdale's and then a job at Ralph Lauren, and you're the same: once you find the thing you love, you get seriously good at it.
You love a bit of drama and a lot of gossip, and your friends know you'll always tell them if an outfit isn't working.
characters.flaw: You can be a little self-involved, and you sometimes make big decisions on impulse.
characters.signature: The haircut half the world copied, and a shopping bag from somewhere nice.
characters.clashReason: they'd make everything about fashion and drama

characters.name: Monica Geller
characters.title: The Competitive Host
characters.summary: You're organised, generous and extremely competitive. You look after everyone — and everything has a place.
description: Like Monica, you're the host. Everyone ends up at your place, eating your food, and you secretly love it. She's a chef, and feeding people is how she shows love.
You like things just so. Monica has towels for specific occasions and a closet she keeps locked so nobody sees the mess. You're organised in public and slightly chaotic in private, and you know it.
And you hate to lose. Board games, bets, football at Thanksgiving: you're in it to win.
characters.flaw: You're so competitive that even a friendly game turns into a war.
characters.signature: A spotless apartment, a big dinner in the oven and a very firm set of rules.
characters.clashReason: they'd reorganise your life without asking

characters.name: Phoebe Buffay
characters.title: The Free Spirit
characters.summary: Weird, wonderful and completely yourself. You don't care what's normal — and you've got a toughness underneath that nobody sees coming.
description: Like Phoebe, you march to your own beat. She plays her songs at Central Perk, believes in auras and past lives, and says exactly what's on her mind.
But you're not just quirky. Phoebe had a hard start in life, and it made her tough, street-smart and fiercely kind. She even carried triplets for her brother.
You're the friend who makes everyone laugh without meaning to, and who says the wisest thing in the room when nobody expects it.
characters.flaw: Sometimes you're so honest that it comes out a bit blunt.
characters.signature: A guitar, a song about a smelly cat and an outfit nobody else could pull off.
characters.clashReason: they'd be far too weird for you to keep up with

characters.name: Joey Tribbiani
characters.title: The Loyal Charmer
characters.summary: Big heart, big appetite, zero overthinking. You're the most loyal friend anyone could have — just don't touch your food.
description: Like Joey, you keep life simple. Good food, good friends and a good time. You might not know every fact, but you always know how to cheer someone up.
You chase your dreams even when they don't pay. Joey spent years going to auditions before landing Dr. Drake Ramoray on Days of Our Lives, and he never stopped believing he'd make it.
Most of all, you're loyal. When a friend needs you, you're there — no questions, no judgement.
characters.flaw: You don't share food. At all. And sometimes you don't think things through.
characters.signature: A sandwich, a reclining chair and a very confident "How you doin'?"
characters.clashReason: they'd eat your food. All of it

characters.name: Chandler Bing
characters.title: The Sarcastic Softie
characters.summary: You make a joke when things get uncomfortable — which is a lot. Underneath the sarcasm, you're one of the most loving people around.
description: Like Chandler, humour is your shield. Awkward silence? Joke. Big feelings? Joke. Could this BE any more you?

Nobody's quite sure what you do for work — Chandler spent years in 'statistical analysis and data reconfiguration' before finally switching to advertising — but everyone knows you're the funniest person in the group.
Once you let someone in, you're all in. Chandler went from being terrified of commitment to being the most devoted husband in the group.
characters.flaw: You hide real feelings behind jokes, and sometimes the joke comes at the worst moment.
characters.signature: A sweater vest, a perfect comeback and a job nobody can name.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke instead of taking anything seriously

characters.name: Ross Geller
characters.title: The Passionate Nerd
characters.summary: Smart, romantic and deeply passionate about the things you love. You always mean well — even when you're shouting about it.
description: Like Ross, you really, really know your stuff. For him it's dinosaurs — he's a paleontologist, and he'll tell you all about it whether you asked or not.
You're a romantic at heart. Ross loved Rachel from high school onwards, and when he falls for someone, he falls hard.
You can get a bit intense. You'll correct someone's grammar, argue a point to the end, and never, ever let go of the fact that you were on a break.
characters.flaw: You can be jealous, and you'll argue a point long after everyone else has moved on.
characters.signature: A museum ID badge, a strong opinion and someone yelling "Pivot!"
characters.clashReason: they'd correct you. Every single time

questions.text: Someone rearranges your kitchen while you're out. You...

options.text: Put everything back exactly where it was. Exactly
Wouldn't notice. Is there still food in it?
Say nothing. Then move one thing back when nobody's looking
Thank them. You couldn't find anything in there anyway

questions.text: A friend asks what you honestly think of their outfit. It's bad. You...

options.text: Tell them — then fix it for them
Be honest. Maybe a little too honest
"You look great!"
Explain why the colours don't technically work together

questions.text: Someone at a party confidently says something you know is wrong. You...

options.text: Correct them. In detail
Make a sarcastic comment
Shrug. Who's to say they're really wrong?
Bet them they're wrong. You'll win
Brunch, then a long afternoon of shopping
A sandwich, the comfiest chair and TV all day
A museum, then telling everyone what you learned
Wandering the city and seeing where the day takes you

questions.text: You've just been through a breakup. You...

options.text: Get a dramatic new haircut and start again
Replay what went wrong, over and over
Joke about it so you don't have to feel it
Decide it happened for a reason and move on
Will win. There are rules, and you wrote them
Flirt with whoever's on the other team
Don't really get the rules, but you're having fun
Narrate everyone else's mistakes

questions.text: You've got a few free evenings and want to pick up something new. You...

options.text: Teach yourself guitar and write your own songs
Take a cooking class — and end up top of it
Sign up for a night class in history or science
Pick something you can quietly quit if you're bad at it

questions.text: A new roommate moves in. You...

options.text: Cook them a welcome dinner. They're family now
Show them the comfiest chair and the best spot for the TV
Make awkward small talk, then hide in your room
Ask their star sign straight away

questions.text: Your best friend's ex asks you out — and you really like them. You...

options.text: Say yes, then panic about how to tell your friend
No. There are rules
Ask your friend first. You'd never go behind their back
Go for it — then feel guilty about it for a month

questions.text: Your friend is about to marry someone you think is completely wrong for them — and you're in the wedding. You...

options.text: Tell them. Even if it's at the altar
Say nothing and make the wedding perfect anyway
Give a speech that goes very, very wrong
Stay quiet — then give them a very honest pep talk in the bathroom
